commands.name: env
commands.description:
Print a structured .NET environment report: SDKs, runtimes, global tools, IDEs,
and PATH anomalies

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

commands.name: gitignore
commands.description:
Diff the local .gitignore against the GitHub Visual Studio template and report
missing rules. Optionally merge them

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --merge
options.description:
Appends all missing rules to the local .gitignore, grouped by
section. Original content is preserved

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Repository root path to check. Defaults to current directory

commands.name: health
commands.description:
Analyze .NET projects for health issues: outdated TFMs, vulnerable/outdated
packages, and missing MSBuild properties

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --outdated
options.description: Check for outdated NuGet packages (requires internet)

options.name: --vulnerable
options.description: Check for vulnerable NuGet packages (requires internet)

options.name: --tfm
options.description: Minimum acceptable TFM (e.g., net8.0). Default: net8.0

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root path to scan. Defaults to current directory

commands.name: nuget
commands.description:
Scan for NuGet package version mismatches across projects and optionally
consolidate to the highest version

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --clear-cache
options.description:
Clears all local NuGet caches (global packages, http,
temp). Skipped if Visual Studio is running

options.name: --consolidate
options.description:
Auto-consolidate mismatched packages to the highest
detected version (rewrites project files)

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root path to scan. Defaults to current directory

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information
